info.name: MovieDB
info.summary: Personal movie and TV show database to track what you've watched
info.description:
# MovieDB - Personal Movie & TV Database
Track all the movies and TV shows you've watched with rich metadata from TMDB.
## Features
- **Movie Tracking**: Log movies with where you watched them (Netflix, Disney+, cinema, etc.) - **TV Show Tracking**: Track series at the episode level — see progress per season, an "up next" card, and bulk-mark whole seasons or series as watched - **Rewatch Support**: Log multiple viewings of the same movie with separate ratings and dates - **TMDB Integration**: Automatically fetch posters, cast, plot, and episode data - **Personal Ratings**: Rate movies and shows 1–10 and write your own reviews - **Watch History**: Full watch history per title, including per-viewing platform, language, and date - **Watchlist**: Maintain a mixed movie + TV watchlist with priorities and a random picker - **Filtering & Sorting**: Filter by genre, platform, and favorites, and sort in either direction - **Statistics**: Dashboard with viewing stats by genre, platform, episodes watched, and total runtime - **Shared Libraries**: Create named libraries and share your collection with other Nextcloud users — assign viewer or editor roles, manage members, and switch between libraries from one account
## Getting Started
1. Get a free API key from [TMDB](https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api) 2. Enter your API key in the app settings 3. Start adding movies and TV shows to your collection!
